title: Mechanistic insights into the visible light photocatalytic activity of g-C3N4/Bi2O2CO3–Bi4O7 composites for rhodamine B degradation and hexavalent chromium reduction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16643-16653
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00969C, Paper
Open Access

Aleena Majeed, Samna Hassan, Musarrat Zahra, Iqra Rafique, Sajid Iqbal, Munib Ahmad Shafiq, Rashid Nazir Qureshi, Ramzan Akhtar, Muhammad Rehan, Mohsin Ali Raza Anjum, Sheeraz Mehboob, Jaweria Ambreen, Jae Ho Yun, Muhammad Saifullah
The CN/BO-24 composite, having 24 wt% of Bi2O2CO3–Bi4O7 (BO) loaded on g-C3N4, degrades 98.3% rhodamine B within 45 min, surpassing both pristine g-C3N4 (90.6%) and BO (9.4%).
